Subject: Quick recap + next steps (Hosted vs Dedicated)

Hi Eric - great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery call and suggested next steps so we're aligned: 

- Key goal: <BrightPath> needs reliable sub-200ms modal latency for real-time triage routing, consistent throughput for up to ~120 req/s during business hours, and SOC 2 controls.
- Current pain: you mentioned the production burst last week caused request queuing and an incident where some requests timed out for ~10 minutes.
- Constraints: must hit HIPAA-adjacent controls for logging, and procurement wants predictable monthly costs.

Recommendation from our side: short-term mitigation on Hosted (rate-limit + cache tuning) + 2-week Dedicated pilot to validate throughput and isolation. If encryption/network controls need to be customer-managed, we should evaluate Private (VPC) in parallel.

Next steps:
1) Can you share the incident timeline and any logs you're comfortable sending (redacted) by EOD Tue?
2) I'll loop in Solutions (Laura) and AE (Rishi) to scope a Dedicated pilot and draft an SOW/quote.
3) Proposed meeting: Wed 5/20 10am PT for technical next steps and procurement check-in.

Thanks - Marissa

Asks:

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Sullivan <eric.sullivan@brightpathhealth.com>, procurement@brightpathhealth.com
Date: 2026-05-17T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick recap + next steps (Hosted vs Dedicated) - technical readout

Hi all - reviewed the logs Eric sent. Quick notes: 

- Root cause appears to be a sudden sustained concurrency spike combined with our default request queueing policy on Hosted. When concurrency exceeds autoscale thresholds, requests enter the shared queue and latency balloons.
- Dedicated pilot should remove shared queuing (dedicated GPU pool + pinned model instance). For the traffic profile shown (120 req/s sustained, peaks ~180 req/s), a Dedicated pool with 2-3 mid-tier GPUs (quantization + batching) looks sufficient for the pilot. Estimated lead time to provision pilot infra: 3 business days for internal allocation + 1 day to run smoke tests.
- Private (VPC) is recommended if BrightPath requires customer-managed network and strict tenancy/isolation. That path adds ~2-3 weeks for onboarding and security review.

Short-term mitigations (to buy time):
- Apply temporary stricter concurrency caps per customer key and move to adaptive 95th percentile throttling.
- Enable prefix/KV caching for common requests to shave token cost and reduce downstream compute.

I'll prepare a pilot scope doc and an infra checklist for provisioning. If AE/legal can get procurement's must-haves, we can draft a 30-day pilot SOW and pricing sheet.
 Laura
